name: Freestyle / rap battle (song ad, rapper on screen)
state: BQE retired 2026-10-22 (opened on the problem); Barber rewritten story-first

signed.ruling: "it's a song ad, but the formats are different, so be cognizant of these little things. But yeah, bro, this is it. Let's run this shit up" — its own playbook, not a copy of the song ad.

what: A New York freestyle or street rap battle made in Suno: our clean-shaven man roasts the bearded man's neck (bumps, the beard he hides behind, the breakup he's hiding from) with yo-mama bars, the other man fires back, our man flips it to the jawline and closes on one line of real talk: use the FLEX. The rappers are ON SCREEN and lip-sync every bar; the crowd or the booth reacts on every punchline; a funny pop-up pictures each joke. Entertainment first, the product is one line at the end.

differs_from_song_ad.what: the rappers are on screen and their lips move to every bar
differs_from_song_ad.song_ad: nobody talks; silent clips under a sung story

differs_from_song_ad.what: rapped battle bars, no chorus, no singing; the crowd is part of the track
differs_from_song_ad.song_ad: a sung story with a hook and a bridge

differs_from_song_ad.what: one setting (a street corner or a radio booth), shot like the battle or freestyle videos
differs_from_song_ad.song_ad: six or more animated story settings

differs_from_song_ad.what: a pop-up insert pictures every punchline
the product is one spoken line at the close, and the real FLEX in our man's hand
differs_from_song_ad.song_ad: the product rendered in the film's style, held by the cast, plus an end card

specialised.what: story order is fixed: the girl / the conflict / the tragedy and the weird detail FIRST, then the problem (the neck, the beard he hides behind), then every failed fix, then the comeback, then the flip to the solution. Never open on the problem or the product
specialised.why: the owner 2026-10-22: "We don't go straight for the pitch, never. That's the whole point of this format" — same order as the animated song ads

specialised.what: the track is made and picked before any picture; the cut follows its clock
specialised.why: same as every song ad: the bars set the timing (SONG-WRITING.md)

specialised.what: the first bar is the hardest bar and is rapped inside 2 s; that bar is also the caption, in quotes
specialised.why: every top coldfreestylesonly post captions its hardest bar in quotes; the owner's verse-first rule (2026-10-21)

specialised.what: crowd noise only in square-bracket tags ([Crowd erupts]); never a round-bracket stage note
specialised.why: BQE take 2 rapped "(Crowd going crazy)" out loud (2026-10-22)

specialised.what: scenes are set-ups, never bars or lines (VIDEO-RULINGS V35): one place and camera set-up per scene with a clear start and stop, the bars played inside; one start picture per scene, a returning set-up reuses its picture
specialised.why: the owner 2026-10-23: "less frames and more just describing what's in the scene … we spent so much for no reason"

specialised.what: a face-off, not a showcase: inches apart, nobody steps back; the crowd a tight circle pressed in; the opponent fights back with his face; handheld, low, hard club light
specialised.why: the owner 2026-10-23: "head-to-head in a face-off and are intense … 8 Mile … we cannot fuck this up"

specialised.what: the opponent and the crowd react on every punchline: a cut to the other man's face, the circle going OHHH
specialised.why: the reaction sells the bar (every freestyle swipe cuts to the host or crew on the punchline)

specialised.what: one pop-up per punchline, 0.6 to 1.0 s, picturing the joke literally, then straight back
specialised.why: the owner 2026-10-22: "pop up little inserts … make it funny/weird"

specialised.what: lookalike TYPES only: build, cut, fit and energy a viewer half-recognises; never a real person's face or name
specialised.why: the sports_generated lookalike skits pull millions; a real likeness is never ours to use

specialised.what: the product is advice between men, once, at the close; the real FLEX is in his hand in that shot; no price, no offer
specialised.why: the owner: "we're not even selling anything anymore, we're just making content that people wanna watch"

specialised.what: every bar is a lip-synced clip of the rapper saying it, cut at bar boundaries
specialised.why: the swipes are all performance: the face saying the line is the content
